record.title: Kenya Somalia security closure continuing into research window
record.scope: Mandera Belet Hawo; Liboi Dhobley; Kiunga Ras Kamboni
record.crossings: Mandera Belet Hawo; Liboi Dhobley; Kiunga Ras Kamboni
record.movement: General land passenger and commercial movements
record.exceptions: Miraa road-export permission at Mandera, Liboi and Kiunga reported by 6 February 2026; exact effective date and first passage unverified. Informal passage also reported.
record.enforcement: Formal closure of named border points. Kenya MOD explicitly acknowledged that the porous boundary remained crossed for illicit trade, human trafficking and narcotics; universal physical closure is not established.
record.status_observation: Closure last confirmed 2026-05-14; no later status inferred
record.official_rationale: Al-Shabaab attacks; reporting also cites illicit weapons/contraband smuggling for initial closure. In 2026 Ruto attributed delayed general reopening to Somali army–Jubaland fighting.
record.context: 2023 and February2026 reopening announcements did not demonstrate actual reopening.
record.uncertainty: A 2007 asylum-related closure is separately documented. Continuity and scope between 2007 and October2011 remain unresolved. No exact completed duration.
